newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares seen stable despite Dow's rally.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares seen stable despite Dow's rally.

text.p: Hungarian share prices were seen moving little on Wednesday, with oil company MOL among the most active issues on the last day of its domestic IPO, traders said.
"MOL will be a quite important factor in market movement as it has been in the last couple of days," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings.
But Czipo added that he did not expect any great movement in the market, saying it might move 0.5 percent to one percent higher at most, with little linkage to Wall Street.
He said that of the three earnings reports released on Wednesday, for meat processor Pick, Graboplast and drugs maker Egis, one was "not so good".
Analysts picked Egis shares to fall after the company reported a Q1 after-tax profit of 1.796 billion forints and said domestic sales were short of target and below last year's figures.
"It was not so good and it will go down," said Sandor Szendi of Postabank Securities.
On Tuesday the BUX index closed at 5,827.24 points, down 102.63.
